userStories.title: Cost ledger records existing dispatch attribution
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Persist existing round-trip attribution, error-model attribution, and usage-missing successful dispatches in schema-v4 cost rows.

**Motivation** — Without `roundTrips` on a cost row, `cacheRead` is the only proxy for loop length, and it cannot separate a long transcript from many turns.

**Approach** — Both stories follow the precedent `blockingThreshold` set in #1907: the value is read off the record the op returned, forwarded by the emitter, and persisted by the existing writer. No new computation is introduced anywhere — every value this feature persists is already computed correctly upstream.

`roundTripUnit` travels with `roundTrips` because the two units are not comparable quantities: native counts model completions, ACP counts delegated agent runs. A consumer that averages them without the discriminator produces a meaningless number, so the count is never persisted alone.

**Scope** — In: CostEvent/DispatchErrorEvent shape updates, error model forwarding, v4 cost-row construction, and optional-token-safe cost aggregation. Out: US-002 review decision and audit work; Backfilling, rewriting or migrating cost rows already written at `schemaVersion` 3 is out of scope. The schema version is how a consumer distinguishes them.; The atomicity of `CostAggregator.drain()` under concurrent record-and-drain is out of scope and unchanged by this feature.

**Interface** — Baselines below are stated only to locate the code; they are never the interface to implement. The `Target:` line is the contract. — `CostEvent` — `src/runtime/cost-aggregator.ts:3` (US-001)
- Baseline: carries `ts`, `runId`, `agentName`, `model`, `stage`, `sessionRole`, `tokens`, `estimatedCostUsd`, `exactCostUsd`, `costUsd`, `confidence`, `pricingSource`, `durationMs` and related optional attribution fields.
- Target: the same, plus optional `roundTrips` (number), `roundTripUnit` (`"model-call" | "agent-run"`), and `usageMissing` (boolean) — **and `tokens` becomes optional.** It is required today (`cost-aggregator.ts:50`) while `CostErrorEvent.tokens` is already optional (`:113`) for exactly the reason AC-10 restates: a zeroed `tokens` re-creates the "failed versus cost-zero" ambiguity. AC-10 cannot be satisfied without this change.

`DispatchErrorEvent` — `src/runtime/dispatch-events.ts:130` (US-001)
- Baseline: carries `agentName`, `stage`, `errorCode`, `durationMs`, `sessionRole`, `tokenUsage`, `estimatedCostUsd`, `exactCostUsd`; it carries no model at all.
- Target: the same, plus an optional `model` string.

`COST_ROW_SCHEMA_VERSION` — `src/runtime/middleware/cost.ts:38` (US-001)
- Baseline: `3`.
- Target: `4`, with the doc comment above it extended to state what a v4 row guarantees, following the convention already used for the v2/v3 boundary.

Symbols this feature reads but does not change:
- `attachCostSubscriber(bus, aggregator, runId, projectKey?)` — `src/runtime/middleware/cost.ts:40`. The only subscriber that builds cost rows.
- `buildDispatchErrorEvent` — `src/agents/manager-dispatch.ts:179`. The only producer of a `DispatchErrorEvent`.
- `modelAttribution()` — `src/agents/manager-dispatch.ts:45`. Already resolves the model for the success path; the error path reuses it.
- `buildSessionTurnEvent` — `src/agents/manager-dispatch.ts:59`. Already stamps `roundTrips` and `roundTripUnit` onto the dispatch event at `:104-105`.
acceptanceCriteria: When a session-turn dispatch event carrying `roundTrips: 7` and `roundTripUnit: "model-call"` is emitted on the dispatch bus, then its recorded cost row has `roundTrips` equal to `7`.
When that dispatch event is emitted, then its recorded cost row has `roundTripUnit` equal to `"model-call"`.
When a session-turn dispatch event carrying `roundTrips: 3` and `roundTripUnit: "agent-run"` is emitted, then its recorded cost row has `roundTripUnit` equal to `"agent-run"`.
When a `complete`-kind dispatch event is emitted, then its recorded cost row omits both `roundTrips` and `roundTripUnit` rather than defaulting them to `1`.

When `buildDispatchErrorEvent` builds an error event for a dispatch with resolved model attribution, then the returned `DispatchErrorEvent.model` equals the model resolved by `modelAttribution()` for that dispatch.
When a dispatch error event carrying `model: "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5"` is emitted, then its recorded error row has `model` equal to `"anthropic/claude-sonnet-5"`.
When a dispatch error event carrying no model is emitted, then its recorded error row omits `model` rather than the string `"unknown"`.
When a successful session-turn dispatch event has undefined `tokenUsage` and `exactCostUsd: 0`, then emitting it records exactly one cost row.
When that usage-less successful session-turn dispatch is recorded, then its cost row has `usageMissing` equal to `true`.
When that usage-less successful session-turn dispatch is recorded, then its cost row has no `tokens` field rather than a tokens object with `input` and `output` both `0`.
When a successful session-turn dispatch event carries token usage, then its recorded cost row omits `usageMissing`.
When a session-turn dispatch event is recorded, then its cost row has `schemaVersion` equal to `4`.
When a dispatch error event is recorded, then its error row has `schemaVersion` equal to `4`.

routing.reasoning: Existing forwarding paths span middleware, event interfaces, the dispatch builder, and optional-token aggregation, but use established patterns and direct bus tests.

modifiedFiles.reason: two assertions break against a correct implementation. The test named `"#1464: rows carry schemaVersion 3"` (`:528-536`) asserts `schemaVersion` is exactly `3`; under AC-12 it becomes `4`. The test named `"skips emit when no tokenUsage and no exactCostUsd"` (`:105`) asserts that this dispatch records nothing; under AC-8 it records exactly one row carrying `usageMissing: true`. US-001 owns updating both to the new invariants.

userStories.title: Review audit records model verdict provenance
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Forward a valid adversarial model pass claim through the decision event into the persisted review audit record.

**Motivation** — Without `modelPassed`, a `passed:true` verdict carrying an `error`-severity finding cannot be attributed to the model's own claim or to a miscomputed verdict.

**Approach** — Both stories follow the precedent `blockingThreshold` set in #1907: the value is read off the record the op returned, forwarded by the emitter, and persisted by the existing writer. No new computation is introduced anywhere — every value this feature persists is already computed correctly upstream.

The `modelPassed` forwarding is guarded by extending the existing field-forwarding canary at
`test/unit/execution/story-orchestrator/review-decision-field-forwarding.test.ts`,
which drives the real `verify()` rather than a hand-authored fixture.

**Scope** — In: payload/event shapes, boolean narrowing, parsed and unparsed emission, audit subscriber/writer persistence, and canary extension. Out: US-001 cost ledger changes; Repairing the adversarial verdict path that allowed ten historical records to carry `passed:true` beside an `error`-severity finding is out of scope for this feature. It requires the `modelPassed` data this feature makes observable, and is deferred to a follow-up.

**Interface** — Baselines below are stated only to locate the code; they are never the interface to implement. The `Target:` line is the contract. — `ReviewDecisionPayload` — `src/execution/story-orchestrator/review-decision.ts:13` (US-002)
- Baseline: carries `reviewer`, `parsed`, `passed`, `failOpen`, `result`, `unparsedPreview`, `acks`, `blockingThreshold`.
- Target: the same, plus an optional `modelPassed` boolean.

`ReviewDecisionEvent` — `src/runtime/dispatch-events.ts` (US-002)
- Baseline: declares `blockingThreshold`, `acks`, `acDropped`, `advisoryFindings`, `unparsedPreview`, `diffAvailable` and the adversarial analysis fields; it declares no `modelPassed`.
- Target: the same, plus an optional `modelPassed` boolean.

Only the adversarial op populates `modelPassed` — `SEMANTIC_OUTPUT_KEYS` in the canary does not list it, and `semanticReviewOp.verify()` does not set it. This feature does not add it to the semantic path; a semantic output simply has no `modelPassed`, which is the absent input class AC-3 pins.

Symbols this feature reads but does not change:
- `emitReviewDecision` — `src/execution/story-orchestrator/review-decision.ts:84`. The only live emitter of `review-decision`.
- `AdversarialReviewOutput.modelPassed` — `src/operations/adversarial-review.ts:81`, populated by `verify()` at `:567`.
acceptanceCriteria: When `toReviewDecisionPayload` receives an adversarial op output whose `modelPassed` is `true`, then it returns a payload whose `modelPassed` is `true`.
When `toReviewDecisionPayload` receives an adversarial op output whose `modelPassed` is `false`, then it returns a payload whose `modelPassed` is `false`, rather than dropping the field as falsy.
When `toReviewDecisionPayload` receives an op output carrying no `modelPassed`, then it returns a payload that omits `modelPassed`.
When `toReviewDecisionPayload` receives an op output whose `modelPassed` is the string `"yes"`, then it returns a payload that omits `modelPassed`.
When the real `adversarialReviewOp.verify()` is driven on output whose model claimed a pass and `emitReviewDecision` is called, then the emitted `ReviewDecisionEvent` carries `modelPassed`.
When `emitReviewDecision` handles an adversarial op output whose `modelPassed` is `false`, then the persisted review audit record has `modelPassed` equal to `false`.

When `emitReviewDecision` handles an op output that failed to parse but carries `modelPassed`, then the persisted audit record preserves `modelPassed`, matching how `blockingThreshold` is read outside the parsed branch.

routing.reasoning: The feature extends an existing unknown-output forwarding seam and audit persistence path, with real-verify canary coverage and no new abstraction.

analysis:
Enhancement of existing event-bus seams. attachCostSubscriber is the sole cost-row builder; it returns early for no usage/zero cost and synthesizes zero tokens (src/runtime/middleware/cost.ts:55-91), while its error path omits model (src/runtime/middleware/cost.ts:119-153). COST_ROW_SCHEMA_VERSION is 3 with a schema-history contract (src/runtime/middleware/cost.ts:5-38). CostEvent requires tokens but CostErrorEvent makes them optional (src/runtime/cost-aggregator.ts:3-113); successful-event aggregation dereferences tokens, so optional successful tokens require zero-safe aggregation (src/runtime/cost-aggregator.ts:224-235). SessionTurnDispatchEvent already declares roundTrips/unit while CompleteDispatchEvent does not (src/runtime/dispatch-events.ts:76-113), and buildSessionTurnEvent already supplies them (src/agents/manager-dispatch.ts:59-117). DispatchErrorEvent and buildDispatchErrorEvent lack model attribution (src/runtime/dispatch-events.ts:130-154; src/agents/manager-dispatch.ts:179-251). Existing cost tests directly exercise the dispatch bus and pin both the obsolete early return and v3 (test/unit/runtime/middleware/cost.test.ts:105-115,528-541); builder/error-path tests are in test/unit/agents/manager-dispatch-error-event.test.ts:1-238.

ReviewDecisionPayload has parsed and unparsed branches in src/execution/story-orchestrator/types.ts:114-159; toReviewDecisionPayload and emitReviewDecision omit modelPassed today (src/execution/story-orchestrator/review-decision.ts:13-132), as does ReviewDecisionEvent (src/runtime/dispatch-events.ts:156-195). The audit subscriber must copy it (src/runtime/middleware/review-audit.ts:31-69), and ReviewAuditEntry/toPersistedEntry must serialize it (src/review/review-audit.ts:45-122,194-226). Adversarial output already declares/populates the field (src/operations/adversarial-review.ts:81,567); semantic does not. The existing canary drives real verify() and already intentionally names modelPassed only in adversarial output keys (test/unit/execution/story-orchestrator/review-decision-field-forwarding.test.ts:1-142).

Compatibility: schema v4 distinguishes new rows; do not backfill v3. Optional successful tokens must remain absent in rows, not zero-filled. Error models remain absent if unresolved, and complete events must omit round-trip values. modelPassed crosses an unknown boundary only after boolean narrowing, preserving false, and must remain absent for semantic output. US-001 and US-002 share no modified symbol and have no dependency.
outOfScope: Repairing the adversarial verdict path that allowed ten historical records to carry `passed:true` beside an `error`-severity finding is out of scope for this feature. It requires the `modelPassed` data this feature makes observable, and is deferred to a follow-up.
Changes to the telemetry analyzer script `analyze.py` are out of scope. It lives outside this repository and no change here can reach it.
Backfilling, rewriting or migrating cost rows already written at `schemaVersion` 3 is out of scope. The schema version is how a consumer distinguishes them.
Making the native path report a wire-exact cost is out of scope. nax-ai supplies rates and computes no cost, so no wire cost exists to report.
The atomicity of `CostAggregator.drain()` under concurrent record-and-drain is out of scope and unchanged by this feature.
Persisting a per-call tool-call count is out of scope. `codingToolUse` exists on the native turn result but not on the ACP path, so it has no cross-transport meaning.
